sentences.en: You must live in the present, not in the past.
sentences.zh: 你必须活在当下，而不是在过去。

sentences.en: The public at large are dissatisfied with the present government.
sentences.zh: 公众普遍对现任政府感到不满。

sentences.en: The ambassador will be recalled from his present post soon.
sentences.zh: 大使很快将被召回，不再担任当前职务。
